title: Grateful Dead Live at Providence Civic Center on 1981-05-13
source: Source Info: Frank Streeter's Master FOB Audience Cassette; Sennheiser 421 mics > Sony TC-D5M (TDK MA90); Transfer Info: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.8 MHz)> KORG AudioGate 4 > Adobe Audition 3.0> TLH flac2496

ai_review.summary: Mediocre 1981 show with a short set and limited jams; recording is acceptable but unremarkable.
ai_review.review: The performance is viewed as a step down from the band's recent New Haven shows, offering solid playing but lacking the extended improvisations that fans expect. The first‑set trio near the end is singled out as a highlight, while the overall set feels compressed and the pre‑drums segment is notably shorter. No recording flaws are mentioned, suggesting an average sound quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one moderate (3‑star) review; comments focus on a lackluster show rather than recording issues, leading to an average overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Review does not comment on soundboard or audience quality; no specific technical complaints noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Short set with a reduced pre‑drums segment (<35 min) and few jams, making the flow feel compressed compared to earlier shows.
